description: This file defines data models and a fetcher class for retrieving ETF holdings data from TMX, including query parameter handling, data normalization, and data transformation logic.

classes.name: TmxEtfHoldingsQueryParams
classes.description: Defines query parameters for TMX ETF holdings requests, including cache usage.

classes.name: TmxEtfHoldingsData
classes.description: Represents individual ETF holding data with fields like symbol, name, weight, shares, market value, etc., and includes a normalization validator.

classes.name: TmxEtfHoldingsFetcher
classes.description: Handles fetching, transforming, and normalizing ETF holdings data from TMX, including static methods for query transformation, data extraction, and data transformation.

methods.name: transform_query
methods.description: Transforms input query parameters by cleaning the symbol string.

methods.name: aextract_data
methods.description: Asynchronously fetches raw ETF holdings data from TMX endpoint, processes it into a standardized format.

methods.name: transform_data
methods.description: Converts raw data dictionaries into validated TmxEtfHoldingsData instances.

methods.name: normalize_percent
methods.description: Normalizes percentage values to a 0-1 scale.
